description: This file defines the RetellSDKClient class which implements the RetellAIRepository interface. It provides methods for managing LLMs, agents, phone numbers, calls, and voices via the Retell SDK, including create, retrieve, update, delete, and list operations. It also handles logging and error management.

classes.name: RetellSDKClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Retell SDK, implementing various methods for managing AI models, agents, phone numbers, calls, and voices.

methods.name: createLLM
methods.description: Creates a new LLM using the Retell SDK and logs the process.

methods.name: getLLM
methods.description: Retrieves an existing LLM by ID.

methods.name: updateLLM
methods.description: Updates an existing LLM with new data.

methods.name: importPhoneNumber
methods.description: Imports a phone number with specific parameters.

methods.name: getPhoneNumber
methods.description: Retrieves details of a phone number.

methods.name: updatePhoneNumber
methods.description: Updates inbound and outbound agent IDs for a phone number.

methods.name: createPhoneCall
methods.description: Creates a phone call with dynamic variables.

methods.name: createWebCall
methods.description: Creates a web call with dynamic variables.
